description: The bar chart illustrates the number of tokens (in thousands) across various categories, with the vertical axis labeled "Tokens (K)" ranging from 0 to 10,000 in increments of 2,000, and the horizontal axis labeled "Categories" displaying eight distinct categories: Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, Science, and Blogs. The bar for "Administrative" reaches 6,472 tokens, the highest among the light blue bars, followed by "Science" at 1,626 tokens. The "Non-fiction" category has 1,889 tokens, "Religion" has 652, "Fiction" has 387, and "Law" has 354. The "Blogs" category has the lowest count at 32 tokens. Notably, the "Law" category is represented by a gray bar with a value of 10,584 tokens, which is the tallest bar in the chart and significantly exceeds all other categories. The bars are arranged in descending order of token count from left to right, with the exception of the "Law" category, which is positioned after "Science" despite having the highest value.
